column1: # Self-hosted bug bounty programs: programs a company runs on its OWN website instead of HackerOne, Bugcrowd and so on
# (Google, Microsoft, Zoho ...). No platform publishes their scope, so you write it down here once; the daily run reads it
# as the source "self-hosted-manual" and everything below goes through the normal parser.
# One line per scope entry. Four columns separated by a TAB (2 or more spaces work too):
# The scope entry can be a host, a wildcard (*.example.com), a URL, an IP range, "a.com, b.com", ...
# Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored. Remove the # from the line below to try it.
